head: Telegram iPhone Duo support: two-column layout on Apple's foldable
dek: Telegram now works on Apple's foldable iPhone Duo: unfolded, it shows your chat list and the open chat side by side, as on the iPad, and folded it looks like the normal iPhone app.
details: Telegram's founder Pavel Durov showed it in a short video on X, joking that Apple had made a phone that is both too big and too small. The iPhone Duo starts at $1,999, with a 5.4-inch outer screen and a 7.6-inch inner screen. Reviewers have said many apps still need updates for its bigger screen.
means: If you have an iPhone Duo, Telegram uses the big inner screen for two panes instead of a stretched phone layout.
todo: Update Telegram from the App Store and open it with the phone unfolded.
thumb_words: TELEGRAM GOES TWO-COLUMN ON IPHONE DUO
